guide: Open Start and type your business name, your utilisation target, the turnaround hours that count as tight and the cancellation notice you ask for in the yellow cells.
Check Vehicles, Vehicle Classes, Channels and Service Blocks: they hold the cars, the turnaround buffer of each class, the fee of each channel and the days a car is off the road.
Enter every booking in Bookings with the car, the class, the channel, the dates, the times and the total. Days, fees, net amount and the turnaround verdict are worked out.
Run the Overlap Check every day and fix every verdict that is not clear before the renter arrives.
Read Calendar by Vehicle and Day and Calendar by Class and Day for the next 14 days, and Next Free Date to find the first free date of a car or a class.
Use Pickups and Returns to plan the counter, the drivers and the cleaner, and to see the knock-on of a late return.
Record each extension in Extension Requests, each swap in Vehicle Swaps and each cancellation or no-show in Cancellations.
Fill gaps with Idle Gaps, and check weekends in Weekend Cars and the Weekend Tool.
Update Channel by Month and Class by Month each month so utilisation and fee figures stay current.
Use the 18 calculators for calendar decisions, print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details written in.
Read the Booking Dashboard and the Charts sheet every week: utilisation, free cars, clashes, cancellations and fees.
A one-car host can use the same sheets with one vehicle and one channel and delete the rows that do not apply.

listing.title: Car Rental Booking Calendar Excel Template: Double-Booking Guard, Fleet Availability, Pickups and Returns, Extensions, Marketplace Fees
listing.headline: See every car, every day, and never double-book a rental again
listing.description:
Run the booking calendar of a small car or van rental in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-operator and a manager who take bookings, plan pickups and returns and keep every car busy. Bookings holds every booking with the car, class, channel, dates, times and total, and works out the days, the channel fee, the net rate per day and a turnaround verdict. Overlap Check sets every booking against the others on the same car. Calendar by Vehicle and Day and Calendar by Class and Day show the next 14 days with rented, reserved, service and free cars. Next Free Date gives the first free date of each car and class.

Pickups and Returns plans the counter and the knock-on of a late return. Extension Requests, Vehicle Swaps and Cancellations record the changes. Idle Gaps, Weekend Cars, Channel by Month, Class by Month and Daily Fleet Status show where cars sit idle and what each channel really pays.

18 calculators answer weekly questions with a clear verdict: the class finder, the double-booking guard, the extension check, the mid-rental swap, the marketplace fee share, the weekend tool, the turnaround buffer, the late return, the cancellation fee, the pace, the marketplace block list and more. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to renters, corporate accounts, a hotel partner, marketplace support, the owner, the manager, drivers, the detailer, the mechanic and the bookkeeper.

This is part two of the Car Rental Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Renters appear by first name and initial only. It helps you keep track of your calendar and does not promise results. Check your local rules and your insurance terms.
